## Thank you for filing a pull request for Woof!

Please make sure that the following conditions are met:

* [ ] Please add a brief description of your changes to the [Changelog](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md), and list it under either *New Features and Improvements*, *Bug Fixes*, or *Miscellaneous*.
* [ ] If your changes contain a significant amount of your own work (measures vary), please add yourself to the list of copyright holders in the source file header and in the [README](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/README.md).
* [ ] If you change or add code or assets *created by others*, please confirm that these contributions are licensed under a GPL-2+-compatible license, and add the applicable license and copyright holder to both the source file header (if applicable) and the [README](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/README.md).
